mapper.insert: INSERT INTO know_posts (id, tag_id, tags, title, description, content_url, content_object_key, content_etag, content_size, content_sha256, creator_id, is_top, type, visible, img_urls, video_url, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tagId}, #{tags}, #{title}, #{description}, #{contentUrl}, #{contentObjectKey}, #{contentEtag}, #{contentSize}, #{contentSha256}, #{creatorId}, #{isTop}, #{type}, #{visible}, #{imgUrls}, #{videoUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE know_posts SET tag_id = #{tagId}, tags = #{tags}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, img_urls = #{imgUrls}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE know_posts SET status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND creator_id = #{creatorId}
mapper.select: SELECT kp.id, kp.title, kp.description, kp.content_url, kp.img_urls, kp.tags, kp.is_top, kp.visible, kp.type, kp.status, kp.publish_time, kp.content_object_key, kp.content_etag, kp.content_size, kp.content_sha256, u.avatar AS author_avatar, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.tags_json AS author_tag_json, 0 AS like_count, 0 AS favorite_count FROM know_posts kp JOIN users u ON kp.creator_id = u.id WHERE kp.id = #{id}

SELECT kp.id, kp.title, kp.description, kp.img_urls, kp.tags, kp.is_top, kp.visible, kp.type, u.avatar AS author_avatar, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.tags_json AS author_tag_json, 0 AS like_count, 0 AS favorite_count FROM know_posts kp JOIN users u ON kp.creator_id = u.id WHERE kp.status = 'published' AND kp.visible = 'public' ORDER BY kp.is_top DESC, kp.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT kp.id, kp.title, kp.description, kp.img_urls, kp.tags, kp.is_top, kp.visible, kp.type, u.avatar AS author_avatar, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.tags_json AS author_tag_json, 0 AS like_count, 0 AS favorite_count FROM know_posts kp JOIN users u ON kp.creator_id = u.id WHERE kp.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND kp.status != 'deleted' ORDER BY kp.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
